150|typedef enum {
151|  /** The given UTF-8 input is NULL terminated. */
152|  UTF8PROC_NULLTERM  = (1<<0),
153|  /** Unicode Versioning Stability has to be respected. */
154|  UTF8PROC_STABLE    = (1<<1),
155|  /** Compatibility decomposition (i.e. formatting information is lost). */
156|  UTF8PROC_COMPAT    = (1<<2),
157|  /** Return a result with composed characters. */
158|  UTF8PROC_COMPOSE   = (1<<3),
159|  /** Return a result with decomposed characters. */
160|  UTF8PROC_DECOMPOSE = (1<<4),
161|  /** Strip "default ignorable characters" such as SOFT-HYPHEN or ZERO-WIDTH-SPACE. */
162|  UTF8PROC_IGNORE    = (1<<5),
163|  /** Return an error, if the input contains unassigned codepoints. */
164|  UTF8PROC_REJECTNA  = (1<<6),
165|  /**
166|   * Indicating that NLF-sequences (LF, CRLF, CR, NEL) are representing a
167|   * line break, and should be converted to the codepoint for line
168|   * separation (LS).
169|   */
170|  UTF8PROC_NLF2LS    = (1<<7),
171|  /**
172|   * Indicating that NLF-sequences are representing a paragraph break, and
173|   * should be converted to the codepoint for paragraph separation
174|   * (PS).
175|   */
176|  UTF8PROC_NLF2PS    = (1<<8),
177|  /** Indicating that the meaning of NLF-sequences is unknown. */
178|  UTF8PROC_NLF2LF    = (UTF8PROC_NLF2LS | UTF8PROC_NLF2PS),
179|  /** Strips and/or convers control characters.
180|   *
181|   * NLF-sequences are transformed into space, except if one of the
182|   * NLF2LS/PS/LF options is given. HorizontalTab (HT) and FormFeed (FF)
183|   * are treated as a NLF-sequence in this case.  All other control
184|   * characters are simply removed.
185|   */
186|  UTF8PROC_STRIPCC   = (1<<9),
187|  /**
188|   * Performs unicode case folding, to be able to do a case-insensitive
189|   * string comparison.
190|   */
191|  UTF8PROC_CASEFOLD  = (1<<10),
192|  /**
193|   * Inserts 0xFF bytes at the beginning of each sequence which is
194|   * representing a single grapheme cluster (see UAX#29).
195|   */
196|  UTF8PROC_CHARBOUND = (1<<11),
197|  /** Lumps certain characters together.
198|   *
199|   * E.g. HYPHEN U+2010 and MINUS U+2212 to ASCII "-". See lump.md for details.
200|   *
201|   * If NLF2LF is set, this includes a transformation of paragraph and
202|   * line separators to ASCII line-feed (LF).
203|   */
204|  UTF8PROC_LUMP      = (1<<12),
205|  /** Strips all character markings.
206|   *
207|   * This includes non-spacing, spacing and enclosing (i.e. accents).
208|   * @note This option works only with @ref UTF8PROC_COMPOSE or
209|   *       @ref UTF8PROC_DECOMPOSE
210|   */
211|  UTF8PROC_STRIPMARK = (1<<13),
212|  /**
213|   * Strip unassigned codepoints.
214|   */
215|  UTF8PROC_STRIPNA    = (1<<14)
216|} utf8proc_option_t;

240|typedef struct utf8proc_property_struct {
241|  /**
242|   * Unicode category.
243|   * @see utf8proc_category_t.
244|   */
245|  utf8proc_propval_t category;
246|  utf8proc_propval_t combining_class;
247|  /**
248|   * Bidirectional class.
249|   * @see utf8proc_bidi_class_t.
250|   */
251|  utf8proc_propval_t bidi_class;
252|  /**
253|   * @anchor Decomposition type.
254|   * @see utf8proc_decomp_type_t.
255|   */
256|  utf8proc_propval_t decomp_type;
257|  utf8proc_uint16_t decomp_seqindex;
258|  utf8proc_uint16_t casefold_seqindex;
259|  utf8proc_uint16_t uppercase_seqindex;
260|  utf8proc_uint16_t lowercase_seqindex;
261|  utf8proc_uint16_t titlecase_seqindex;
262|  /**
263|   * Character combining table.
264|   *
265|   * The character combining table is formally indexed by two
266|   * characters, the first and second character that might form a
267|   * combining pair. The table entry then contains the combined
268|   * character. Most character pairs cannot be combined. There are
269|   * about 1,000 characters that can be the first character in a
270|   * combining pair, and for most, there are only a handful for
271|   * possible second characters.
272|   *
273|   * The combining table is stored as sparse matrix in the CSR
274|   * (compressed sparse row) format. That is, it is stored as two
275|   * arrays, `utf8proc_uint32_t utf8proc_combinations_second[]` and
276|   * `utf8proc_uint32_t utf8proc_combinations_combined[]`. These
277|   * contain the second combining characters and the combined
278|   * character of every combining pair.
279|   *
280|   * - `comb_index`: Index into the combining table if this character
281|   *   is the first character in a combining pair, else 0x3ff
282|   *
283|   * - `comb_length`: Number of table entries for this first character
284|   *
285|   * - `comb_is_second`: As optimization we also record whether this
286|   *   character is the second combining character in any pair. If
287|   *   not, we can skip the table lookup.
288|   *
289|   * A table lookup starts from a given character pair. It first
290|   * checks whether the first character is stored in the table
291|   * (checking whether the index is 0x3ff) and whether the second
292|   * index is stored in the table (looking at `comb_is_second`). If
293|   * so, the `comb_length` table entries will be checked sequentially
294|   * for a match.
295|   */
296|  utf8proc_uint16_t comb_index:10;
297|  utf8proc_uint16_t comb_length:5;
298|  utf8proc_uint16_t comb_issecond:1;
299|  unsigned bidi_mirrored:1;
300|  unsigned comp_exclusion:1;
301|  /**
302|   * Can this codepoint be ignored?
303|   *
304|   * Used by utf8proc_decompose_char() when @ref UTF8PROC_IGNORE is
305|   * passed as an option.
306|   */
307|  unsigned ignorable:1;
308|  unsigned control_boundary:1;
309|  /** The width of the codepoint. */
310|  unsigned charwidth:2;
311|  /** East Asian width class A */
312|  unsigned ambiguous_width:1;
313|  unsigned pad:1;
314|  /**
315|   * Boundclass.
316|   * @see utf8proc_boundclass_t.
317|   */
318|  unsigned boundclass:6;
319|  unsigned indic_conjunct_break:2;
320|} utf8proc_property_t;
